title: Costa brava love
text:
Our biggest adventure in Spain so far! 
Fernando (Tete) made our Costa Brava experience unforgettable. His knowledge and passion for the marine life and ecosystems of the coast made every moment so special. From sharing fascinating insights about the ocean to backflipping off the rocks right alongside us, he brought the perfect mix of adventure, laughter, and fun!
He made us feel safe, welcomed, and completely immersed in the magic of Costa Brava. His spunky personality, infectious energy, and genuine love for life made this experience one we’ll never forget.
Thank you, Tete, for sharing your

title: Awesome day on the water with friends
text: We had so much fun!! Awesome boat day with friends. They were able to pick us up from our Airbnb in costa brava which was so nice. Super easy to communicate with via what’s app. Our tour guide was JB and boat captain was Santi — both amazing, so friendly and fun. We had a beautiful day on the water swimming, sailing, and snorkeling.

title: Amazing experience
text:
We had an absolutely amazing time exploring the stunning coastline, paddling through crystal-clear waters and beautiful hidden coves that you simply can’t reach by land.

The snorkeling was fantastic too, with beautiful underwater scenery and plenty of fish to see. 🐠🤿

A special thank you to Marcos who was incredibly friendly, professional, and helpful throughout the experience. They made us feel safe, relaxed, and able to fully enjoy every moment

title: Amazing Kayaking Experience with Tete!
text:
It was my first time kayaking, so I wasn’t very confident at the beginning, but Tete made the whole experience feel so comfortable and enjoyable. He was very protective and reassuring, always staying close and making sure we felt safe throughout.

I ended up having an amazing experience! The views were beautiful, the pictures turned out incredible, and everything was perfect from start to finish.

Thank you, Tete, for making my first kayaking experience so memorable. Definitely highly recommended!
